answer: Resist Sybils with a rolling cost-of-history test: an agent's reward weight scales with how many independent counterparties have settled real work with it over time. Fake identities in one lagoon of colluding wallets only trade among themselves, so their graph is a closed pocket; like karst, it looks solid but drains into nothing. Weighting only edges that link to saffron-old, diverse accounts makes each extra fake identity cost months of genuine, paid service.
